## Portraius Studio: a Director scene

The Tour's sample scene "The Letter, again", shot the way the Director does it: an anchor still per shot (Nano Banana 2.1 at 2K, Fast, the Director's setting), each animated from its anchor, then the takes joined in order. Put a character's sheet and front view in `ComfyUI/input/` as `walt-sheet.jpg` and `walt-front.jpg`: unzip any `.portraius` file, they're `sheet/turnaround.png` and `sheet/front.png`. The samples are in this repo's `public/samples/`.

Every shot here has Walt in its first frame, so each renders on MiniMax H3; a shot without people would take Seedance 2.5's draft and final (see still-first-video). The app draws 2 to 4 anchors per shot for you to pick from; the graph draws one.

Concatenate Video makes straight cuts only: the app's export can also crossfade. A "continue" shot, which starts on the previous shot's last frame, isn't in this scene. Needs a Comfy account with credits: these are partner nodes.

widgets_values:
Image 1 is the reference sheet for LEAD (Walt Harmon). Image 2 is a front portrait of LEAD.
Keep LEAD's exact face, skin tone, skin texture and hair from images 1 and 2. Do not beautify or change their age.
LEAD: Retired harbour pilot. Tall and lean, usually in a navy wool peacoat over a dark knit sweater.
LEAD sits alone in a corner booth of a late-night diner, rain on the window. Location: A late-night diner with red vinyl booths.
Wide shot showing the full figure in the setting, eye-level camera, 35mm lens, shot on a digital cinema camera, clean and detailed, set in the present day, a grounded, dramatic tone.
Natural skin texture with visible pores, real lens imperfections.
